notes: Static support and resistance references for the Overview banner and Daily Levels list. The 50-week and 200-week averages are computed live from price_history.json and are never hardcoded here. Labels follow live spot: a level entirely above price uses overhead_label (resistance to reclaim / overhead); a level entirely below price uses support_label. A zone that contains price is labeled testing. in_banner false means Daily Levels only — the so-what banner keeps its original set.
